# NSW Teachers Federation (NSWTF)

> Professional organization serving NSW teachers with member portal access, library resources, and educational support services.

NSWTF provides essential member services including authentication portals and library catalog access through LIBERO WebOPAC. The organization supports educators through digital resources, journals, and professional development materials.

## Key Topics

- NSW Teachers Federation
- Members Portal
- LIBERO WebOPAC
- Member Login
- Authentication
- Library Collections
- Education Journal
- Member Services
- Library Search
- LGBTIQA+
- Education Quarterly
- Trove
- Password Reset
- WebOPAC Catalog

## Member Access & Authentication

- [Log in – Members Portal – NSWTF](https://members.nswtf.org.au): NSWTF Members Portal login and authentication gateway for member-only resources and services

## Library Resources & Collections

- [LIBERO WebOPAC Search Simple (W501)](https://library.nswtf.org.au/libero/WebOpac.cls): LIBERO WebOPAC library catalog search providing access to NSWTF library collections for members
